title: A targeted cell is removed
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Activated cytotoxic T cells can induce apoptosis in appropriately recognized infected cells, limiting some intracellular infections.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: After recognizing an appropriate infected target, what can a cytotoxic T cell induce in that target? Activated cytotoxic T cells can induce apoptosis in appropriately recognized infected cells, limiting some intracellular infections.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: What can an activated cytotoxic T cell induce in an appropriately recognized target? Cytotoxic T cells can trigger programmed cell death in target cells.

recall.question: What can an activated cytotoxic T cell induce in an appropriately recognized target?
recall.why: Cytotoxic T cells can trigger programmed cell death in target cells.
